Graves, a lighteyed man, leads a group that wants King Elhokar dead so Dalinar will rule. Moash, who blames the king for his grandparents’ deaths, is with them and wears the Shards Kaladin chose to give him.
When the army marched onto the Plains, Dalinar had Bridge Four leave its best man behind, with a team of his own choosing, to guard the king. Kaladin realised that meant Moash.
His leg was torn open fighting the chasmfiend. With Syl gone and no Stormlight to heal him, he has been hobbling about on a crutch.
Wit sang Kaladin the tale of Fleet, a runner who raced the storm itself across the world until it caught him.
The voice that speaks to Dalinar in his visions told him at the end of the last book that it had been killed. In the last chapter he heard that same voice on the battlefield.

quiz.q: Who is guarding the door to the king’s rooms when Kaladin arrives?
o: Two members of the old King’s Guard
Teft and Skar, back from the march
Two of Graves’s men in Bridge Four uniforms
A pair of ardents from the practice grounds
quiz.e: Neither man is Bridge Four or old King’s Guard. Kaladin names them as Graves’s men, and they tell him Moash is off sleeping.

quiz.q: What do the Parshendi teams keep trying to do to Adolin?
o: Shove him over the edge of a nearby chasm
Lasso him with ropes and keep him out of battle
Crack his Plate with bolts of red lightning
Lure him into single combat with their Shardbearer
quiz.e: Rope teams engage and distract him. Adolin realises they don’t mean to defeat him, only to keep a Shardbearer out of the battle.

quiz.q: How does the voice describe itself to Dalinar?
o: The Almighty, returned from death
A Herald who escaped from Damnation
The spirit of his brother Gavilar
The sliver of Him that remains
quiz.e: It says it is not the Almighty but “the one left behind,” the sliver of Him that fled when Odium murdered Him.

quiz.q: What news makes Dalinar take a messenger’s horse?
o: Adolin has been dragged into a chasm
Teleb has fallen and Roion’s army is routed
Aladar’s army has begun to retreat
Navani’s engineers have been overrun
quiz.e: The messenger reports that Teleb has fallen and Roion’s broken army is surrounded on the northern plateau.

quiz.q: What does Navani’s glowing garnet fabrial do?
o: Warms the archers’ numb, wet hands
Holds the tarps up without any poles
Pulls the moisture out of the air
Shields the archers from lightning
quiz.e: It is an attractor, a new invention. Water pools around it, so Roion’s archers can string their bows and shoot across the chasm.

quiz.q: Who stabs Elhokar as Kaladin leads him out?
o: Moash, lying in wait by the door
A servant hiding behind a couch
Graves, shooting from the balcony
One of the guards Kaladin felled
quiz.e: Cleft-chin, one of the door guards, plunges a knife into the king’s side. Kaladin spears him; the knife had glanced off a rib.

quiz.q: What point does Kaladin make about Fleet?
o: Fleet could not win, but kept on running
Fleet escaped the storm by hiding in a cave
Fleet was a king who lost his whole army
Fleet carried a wounded friend to safety
quiz.e: Fleet couldn’t win but ran with all he had. We all die, Kaladin says, so what matters is how well you’ve run.

quiz.q: Who finds Kaladin and the king in the corridor?
o: Moash and Graves, both in Shardplate
Teft and Rock, sent back by Dalinar
Amaram and his personal guard of fifty
Sadeas and two of his officers
quiz.e: Moash arrives in his blue and red Plate with Graves, also a Shardbearer. The assassins have come.

chapters.title: Time’s Illusion
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: A column of mineral deposit rising from a cave floor.

A raised platform, often for a throne or a speaker.

Walled in or shut up inside something.
Shared by everyone in a group.
Smelling stale and damp, like an unaired room.
Sharp and bitter, especially of smoke.

To attack or pester again and again.
Care or help given, especially to the sick or wounded.

Wildly out of control with emotion.
Early in the battle, a scout told Shallan that one central plateau on her map was really a perfect circle, which broke the pattern. Dalinar gave her soldiers and sent Renarin to protect her scholars.
Ten Oathgates once linked the capitals of the ancient kingdoms to Urithiru. Jasnah believed one stood in Stormseat, the ruined city at the heart of the Plains.
A severe scholar in Shallan’s group, who distrusts Pattern and suggested he might be a Voidbringer.
Dalinar told Kaladin that Roshone, who owned silversmith shops, led Elhokar into the affair that killed Moash’s grandparents. Kaladin knew him as the citylord who ruined his family.
When the Assassin in White struck at the palace, Kaladin fought him in its corridors and fell from the building with him, surviving on Stormlight.

quiz.q: How does Shallan know the plateau is the right place?
o: Pattern can hear the portal humming inside
It bears the carved glyph for Urithiru
Rlain told her the Parshendi avoid it
It is a near-perfect circle among broken pieces
quiz.e: The jagged plateaus were made by the shattering. This one is a circle: the raised dais the Oathgate sat on, which broke along its edges.

quiz.q: What alarms Renarin as he stares westward?
o: He sees Parshendi climbing the plateau
The wind is blowing the wrong way
He spots his father’s banner falling
He hears that the singing has stopped
quiz.e: The wind blows from west to east. “It’s actually real,” he says. “The Everstorm.”

quiz.q: How does Adolin reach the singing Parshendi?
o: Through a hollow, buried building
By climbing the outcropping in the rain
Across a bridge his engineers laid
Disguised in captured Parshendi armour
quiz.e: He cuts into the rock mound behind them, which proves to be an old crem-sealed building, and leads a thousand men through it.

quiz.q: How does Adolin feel as he cuts down the singers?
o: Eager, carried along by the Thrill
Proud of a clever plan well done
Sick, with no Thrill to drive him on
Calm, as if fighting a practice duel
quiz.e: It is like killing sleeping men. The Thrill never comes; he feels only nausea and drops his Blade in disgust.

quiz.q: Who strikes Adolin from behind?
o: A Parshendi rope team
A pair of Parshendi archers
The Shardbearer Eshonai
A bolt of red lightning
quiz.e: A Shardblade cracks his breastplate. It is Eshonai, and Adolin, glad of an honest fight, thanks her in his head.

quiz.q: Asked whether it is a spren or a god, what does the voice answer?
o: “Neither”
“A spren”
“A god”
“Both”
quiz.e: It calls itself that which brings light and darkness. Dalinar names it the Stormfather, and it says it is both.

quiz.q: What does Kaladin recognize about the palace hallway?
o: It is where he first met Dalinar
It is where the assassin attacked
It leads down to the treasury
It is where Moash once stood guard
quiz.e: They fought the Assassin in White there; planks now cover the hole the assassin cut through the wall.

quiz.q: Who does Kaladin say was truly behind Moash’s grandparents’ deaths?
o: Roshone
Sadeas
Amaram
Gavilar
quiz.e: He promises to go to Dalinar and see that Moash gets justice against Roshone, “the one truly behind” their deaths.

chapters.title: The One Who Saves
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: A picture made from many small pieces of coloured stone or glass.
A large picture made directly on a wall.
Dulled or discoloured, as metal becomes with age.
Dull greyish-brown; on Roshar, a gemstone whose Stormlight has run out.
A guess based on a feeling rather than proof.
Attacked or pressed again and again.
A risky move made to gain an advantage.
Doing dangerous things without thinking of the consequences.
The jaws of a large animal; any wide, gaping opening.
Useless; having no chance of success.
The very edge of a steep drop.
Came together to form a single mass.
A heavy load, or a hard duty someone must carry.
At the end of the last chapter, Moash closed his faceplate to fight Kaladin, who was bleeding, standing on one good leg and holding only a spear over the unconscious king.
The lighteyed man who leads the plot against King Elhokar. He is here with Moash, both of them in Shardplate.
Dalinar’s younger son, who has Shardplate and a Shardblade. Dalinar ordered him to protect Shallan’s scholars, though Renarin said he felt useless.
Ten Oathgates linked the capitals of the ancient kingdoms to Urithiru. The writings Shallan studied said opening them was the duty of the Knights Radiant.
The Parshendi Shardbearer and general, who has taken stormform. At a parley, Adolin, posing as his father, heard her say there would be peace only when one side was dead.

quiz.q: What does the narrow eleventh section of the floor mosaic show?
o: Ten knights in a ring
A raging highstorm
A tower: Urithiru
The Shattered Plains
quiz.e: Ten segments match the ten orders, kingdoms and peoples. Between the first and tenth is a narrower eleventh showing Urithiru.

quiz.q: What is the slot in the steel disc made to fit?
o: A Shardblade
A royal seal
A large gemstone
A brass key
quiz.e: Renarin’s Blade can’t scratch the metal. When he slides it in, the keyhole flows to match the Blade’s shape.

quiz.q: What does Pattern warn about the two storms?
o: They will cancel each other out over the city
The Weeping’s rain will smother them both
They will both pass far to the south of here
They will collide here and feed each other
quiz.e: The Everstorm from the west and a highstorm from the east will meet here like two waves, making a storm like none the world has seen.

quiz.q: How does Adolin defeat Eshonai?
o: He shatters her helm with his Blade
He shoves her off the plateau’s edge
He cuts her Blade arm free of its Plate
His men pull her down with ropes
quiz.e: Caught up in the Thrill, she ignores her surroundings. Adolin takes a blow to the head, then rams her over the edge into the chasm.

quiz.q: Who keeps Adolin from falling into the chasm?
o: Renarin, reaching down from above
His father, riding up on Gallant
A ledge just below the chasm’s lip
Skar and Drehy, holding his Plate
quiz.e: The two bridgemen grab the steel link skirt of his Plate. Drehy jokes that lifting fat lighteyes is easy.

quiz.q: Whom does Adolin stop on the central plateau?
o: Khal’s son, without Plate
Sadeas, in disguise
The Assassin in White
Amaram, without his cloak
quiz.e: The cloaked man has too-large, rounded eyes, a bald head and filmy clothing: the Assassin in White.

quiz.q: What Words does Kaladin finally speak?
o: I will seek justice for the fallen
I will protect even those I hate
I will remember those I have lost
I will put the law before my friends
quiz.e: He whispers, “I will protect even those I hate, so long as it is right.” The Stormfather reluctantly accepts the Words.

quiz.q: What mistake does Graves say his group made?
o: Focusing on separating Kaladin from Dalinar
Trying to kill the king during the Weeping
Giving Moash a full set of Shards
Waiting too long to strike at the king
quiz.e: The Diagram spoke of this, he says: they made sure Kaladin was separated from Dalinar, not thinking what that might push him to become.

chapters.title: Swallowed by the Sky
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: Struck again and again with heavy blows.
A piece of armour that protects the forearm.
A piece of armour that protects the shin.
In a frantic, excited, almost frenzied way.
A young man who is not yet fully grown.
Dismissive; showing that something is not worth much attention.
Tough, chewy tissue in meat, usually cut away.
In a way meant to fend something off or keep it back.
Strange in an unsettling way, as if beyond the natural.
Fell straight down, fast and steeply.
Believing things that are not real.
A device powered by Stormlight held in gemstones.
In Vorin belief, the heavenly realm from which mankind was driven, where the worthy dead are said to go.
Dalinar led Roion, Aladar and Sebarial deep into the Plains toward the Parshendi. Roion’s plateau was overrun, and Dalinar used Roion’s archers to cover the retreat, while Adolin won his own plateau.

Eshonai meant to save her people’s new storm as a weapon for when the Alethi came; her sister Venli said it would blow “the wrong way.” On the battlefield, Pattern sensed the singing Parshendi crafting a storm, and Renarin named it the Everstorm.

Shallan believes one of the ancient gates to Urithiru stands on a perfectly round plateau. Inside a sealed building there she found a muralled chamber with a slot that reshaped itself around Renarin’s Shardblade.
Dalinar, who gave up his Shardblade to free the bridgemen, has a Blade again: the one the madman in the monastery had carried, which Dalinar secretly bonded and used to expose Amaram.

quiz.q: What does Peet say Shallan expects to collide right where the army stands?
o: A chasmfiend and a Parshendi army
A highstorm and an Everstorm
A flood and a falling plateau
Two waves of Parshendi warriors
quiz.e: Peet relays that a highstorm and something Shallan called an Everstorm are expected to collide right there.

quiz.q: What news does Commander Cael bring Dalinar?
o: Adolin has been cut off and captured
Sadeas’s army has finally arrived
Roion has retaken his lost plateau
Aladar has won his plateau battle
quiz.e: Aladar reports that the singing Parshendi went right down, and the rest broke and fled.

quiz.q: What does Renarin scratch onto the chamber wall with a rock?
o: A sequence of numbers, all zeros
A map of the Shattered Plains
The names of the ten Heralds
A sketch of the red storm building
quiz.e: Crying that he can see the future, Renarin writes a sequence of numbers, all zeros, and whispers “It’s come.”

quiz.q: What does Dalinar urge Adolin to do when he takes the princedom?
o: Make peace with the Parshendi
Hunt down his uncle’s killer
Lead, not play the others’ games
Give all his Shards to Renarin
quiz.e: Don’t let them corrupt you or play their games: “Lead. Don’t follow.” He tells Adolin to unite them.

quiz.q: How does Dalinar catch Szeth’s first swing?
o: With a spear taken from a bridgeman
With his own newly bonded Blade
With Adolin’s fallen Shardblade
With a shield from Navani’s engineers
quiz.e: His Shardblade appears as he raises it; Adolin blesses him for bonding the madman’s Blade.

quiz.q: What truth brings Dalinar peace as he sinks to his knees?
o: Adolin is ready to lead the army
The Almighty has forgiven his past
Szeth will spare both of his sons
He could never have saved Gavilar
quiz.e: Even awake and sober that night, he could not have beaten this creature. He sets down a burden carried for over six years.

quiz.q: Who rushes the assassin with a side sword as he stalks toward Dalinar?
o: Highprince Roion
General Khal
Highprince Aladar
Commander Cael
quiz.e: Roion leads a small force against Szeth, who Lashes him into the sky; he falls to his death.

quiz.q: What does Kaladin claim as he lands before the assassin?
o: The throne, in the king’s name
The Shardblade Szeth carries
The sky, the winds and Szeth’s life
The Parshendi’s storm as his own
quiz.e: “The sky and the winds are mine. I claim them, as I now claim your life.”

chapters.title: Patterns of Light
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: Out of place; not fitting the surroundings.
Loud and resonant, with a ringing or mournful sound.
A huge sea monster; anything enormous.
A long-handled weapon with an axe blade and a spike.
A violent whirlpool; any wild, confused turmoil.
Coming in irregular bursts; not steady.
A central point where things meet or connect.
To put something clearly into words.
After Kaladin broke his promise, Syl faded and the Stormfather said he had killed her. In the palace, Kaladin spoke new Words, and Syl came back as a glowing Shardblade.
When Szeth struck at the king’s palace earlier in this book, he told Dalinar he had come for him. Kaladin fought him there and healed an arm cut by Szeth’s Blade.
Sebarial is the highprince who claims to hate everyone; Palona, his mistress, runs his household and gave Shallan rooms there.
Shallan learned that ten Oathgates once linked the capitals of the Epoch Kingdoms to Urithiru, which is why no two maps agreed on where the city lay.

quiz.q: What does Shallan realise about the round chamber?
o: It is a tomb for ten ancient kings
It is one giant fabrial run on lamps
It is a library of Radiant records
It is a shrine sealed by the Heralds
quiz.e: The ten lamps hold gems in metal latticework: the whole room is a fabrial powered by their Stormlight.

quiz.q: How does Sebarial explain having Dalinar’s supplies?
o: Navani handed them over to him
He bought them from Roion’s men
Aladar sent them along as a gift
He saved them as they blew past
quiz.e: He says they “liberated” Dalinar’s stores, which were blowing past, headed for certain doom.

quiz.q: According to Aladar, what has the day’s victory achieved?
o: The Vengeance Pact is fulfilled
Sadeas has lost his princedom
The Parshendi have sued for peace
Narak is now under Alethi rule
quiz.e: Aladar boasts that Gavilar is avenged and the war is over, then asks why it doesn’t feel different.

quiz.q: Who, according to Syl, rushed the unexpected highstorm?
o: The singing Parshendi warriors
The assassin, using his Blade
Her father, the Stormfather
Renarin, without knowing it
quiz.e: Syl says her father is broken and wants to wash everyone away and hide from the future.

quiz.q: Why does Shallan pull Adolin’s Blade out of the lock?
o: Pattern warns it will kill Adolin
It is cutting into the steel disc
The floor begins to crack apart
Something is wrong with his Blade
quiz.e: Nothing happens with it in the slot; she realises something is wrong with all Blades but hers, and uses her own.

quiz.q: What does Shallan find when Adolin cuts a new doorway?
o: The whole plateau is at Urithiru
Only the chamber has moved away
The storm has passed over Narak
The army was swept into chasms
quiz.e: The same plateau, with four armies on it, now sits sunlit in a ring of ten beside the tower city. The plateau was the portal.

quiz.q: What does Kaladin call Szeth for blaming his orders?
o: A madman beyond all saving
A coward, not an evil man
A traitor to his own people
A slave who chose his chains
quiz.e: If orders were why he murdered, Kaladin says, he is not the evil man Kaladin assumed, but a coward.

quiz.q: How does Kaladin end the fight with Szeth?
o: He drives a spear into his heart
He Lashes him to a falling plateau
He cuts through Szeth’s wrist
He hurls him into the red storm
quiz.e: Szeth closes his eyes to accept the blow; Kaladin diverts it through his wrist, and Szeth drops his sword and falls.

chapters.title: The Riddens
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: A musical quality, as in a voice.
Cruel or unjust treatment by those in power.
Made quickly from whatever is at hand.
A dazed state in which one can barely think or act.
A sheltered spot protected from highstorms, where gentler plants can grow.
In the palace, Moash and Graves tried to kill the unconscious King Elhokar. When Kaladin spoke new Words and Syl returned, both fled.
When Kaladin fought with other Shardblades, he heard a scream in his mind. Pattern told Shallan that thousands of spren were killed in the Recreance.
Citing Jasnah’s belief that parshmen are dangerous, Shallan asked Dalinar to march onto the Plains without them, and he agreed.
The parshman Bridge Four took in and tattooed as one of their own. Before leaving, he told Kaladin his name was not Shen but Rlain.

quiz.q: Why, according to Syl, doesn’t Szeth’s Blade scream when Kaladin holds it?
o: Kaladin has already bonded it
It is not a spren at all
Its spren is merely asleep
Syl is shielding his mind
quiz.e: Syl says it is not a spren but likely one of the Honorblades, the swords of the Heralds; anyone holding it becomes a Windrunner.

quiz.q: Whom does Kaladin at first take Rlain for?
o: One of Lopen’s cousins
A soldier of Sebarial’s
A Horneater from Rock’s family
One of Dalinar’s scouts
quiz.e: In the chamber he mistakes the tall man for a cousin of Lopen’s, until he sees the skullplate is not a cap.

quiz.q: What does Teft say he saw just before Kaladin arrived?
o: The Parshendi bowing to Dalinar
Szeth’s Blade lying abandoned
A couple of the lads glowing
Syl flying ahead of the storm
quiz.e: He swears a couple of the bridgemen glowed faintly with Stormlight, and suspects the Radiant orders included more than the knights.

quiz.q: What does Teft tell Kaladin about his eyes?
o: They glow red like the Parshendi’s
They have gone dark as a slave’s
They are bloodshot from the storm
They are paler than any king’s
quiz.e: Teft says they are pale blue, like glassy water, lighter than any king’s, which troubles Kaladin.

quiz.q: What did travel through the Oathgate cost the army?
o: Most of the gemstones they carried
All of the food they had brought
The lives of a hundred soldiers
Shallan’s ability to see Pattern
quiz.e: The trip drained most of the gemstones on the plateau, even Navani’s fabrials; more people needs more Light.

quiz.q: Where has Kaladin hidden the wounded Elhokar?
o: In a monastery in Sebarial’s camp
In the barracks of Bridge Four
In a Herdazian home in Little Herdaz
In a mansion in Aladar’s warcamp
quiz.e: Elhokar is in Lopen’s family’s home in Little Herdaz, where Lopen’s mother scolds him into eating.

quiz.q: What does Lopen find after his Stormlight winks out?
o: A new glyph burned into his palm
A spren hiding inside his sphere
His eyes have turned a pale shade of blue
New flesh sprouting at his shoulder
quiz.e: A new nub of flesh is growing from the scar where he lost his arm.

quiz.q: Whom does Graves say was right about what is coming?
o: Dalinar Kholin
Jasnah Kholin
Highprince Sadeas
Navani Kholin
quiz.e: Talking of the Everstorm and parshmen as Voidbringers, Graves says “That woman was right”: Jasnah Kholin.

chapters.title: The Man Who Owned the Winds
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: Required; needed for a particular purpose.
Someone who follows accepted rules and customs rather than standing apart.
A quick, clever, slightly mocking remark.
Spending or using far more than is reasonable.
To feel or show great joy at a success.
A mass departure of many people at once.
Wildly hurried and out of control.
Thinking clearly and sensibly, especially after confusion.
A phrase repeated over and over.
Speech or action that shows disrespect for something held sacred.
Acts of care or help, especially for someone sick or hurt.
A person’s natural character and way of reacting.
A paired writing device of Roshar that copies whatever one pen writes onto a distant partner.
Shallan joined the secret Ghostbloods in disguise as “Veil”, reporting to the scarred, gentlemanly Mraize, who calls her “little knife”.
Shallan’s father had a Soulcaster that broke. The Ghostbloods, who had given it to him, wanted it back.

A man who arrived at Kholinar carrying a Shardblade is kept in Dalinar’s monastery, whispering the same words over and over. His name is almost that of Talenelat’Elin, one of the Heralds. Shallan once saw Amaram sneak into his room.
Before the march, Dalinar proved that Amaram had murdered his own men to take a Shardblade and Plate. Amaram gave up his Radiant cloak and walked away with his guard of fifty.
The Shin assassin in white. His people named him Truthless and banished him for claiming that the Voidbringers had returned.

quiz.q: What is written beneath the Ghostbloods’ symbol on the card Shallan finds?
o: Veil’s name, in Mraize’s hand
Shallan’s own name, not Veil’s
A room number deeper in the tower
A warning to leave Urithiru
quiz.e: The card bears the Ghostbloods’ triangle and, beneath it, Shallan’s name rather than Veil’s. She has been found out.

quiz.q: What does Mraize say he has done with Shallan’s brothers?
o: Taken them hostage until she obeys
Sent them into hiding in Kharbranth
Rescued them and is bringing them here
Sold their lands to settle their debts
quiz.e: He says he rescued them from the succession war and is bringing them to her safely, as a gift and not as blackmail.

quiz.q: What does Shallan find in the strongbox behind the painting?
o: A small Shardblade, thrust in hastily
Her mother’s letters to her secret lover
Her father’s broken Soulcaster
A pouch of blackbane and a key
quiz.e: The Blade was Pattern. Her father tried to hide it there, but it vanished into mist as soon as he closed the box.

quiz.q: What did Shallan’s father let everyone believe?
o: That his wife ran off with a lover
That bandits had murdered his wife on the road
That his wife had died of a fever
That he killed his wife and her lover
quiz.e: He took the blame to protect Shallan. When her mother came at her with a knife, Shallan was the one who killed them, with her Blade.

quiz.q: According to Amaram’s letter, why did the Sons of Honor need a crisis?
o: To bring back the Heralds and the Church
To unite Alethkar under one king
To end the war on the Shattered Plains
To weaken Sadeas before the Desolation
quiz.e: He writes to Restares that to return the Heralds and the Church’s dominance, they had to put the world into a crisis, and that they have succeeded.

quiz.q: Who stops the dart fired at Amaram in the madman’s room?
o: Amaram himself, with his Shardblade
The Herald, snatching it from the air
Pama, the driver of his carriage
A masked guard of the monastery
quiz.e: Talenelat catches two darts, the second inches from Amaram’s face. The masked figure was trying to kill Amaram, not the Herald.

quiz.q: For which order of the Knights Radiant does Nin call Szeth worthy?
o: The Windrunners
The Lightweavers
The Edgedancers
The Skybreakers
quiz.e: Nin, the Herald of Justice, says he has never found a man more worthy of the Skybreakers than Szeth, who kept his word with perfection.

quiz.q: What is strange about the Shardblade Nin gives Szeth?
o: It glows with a cold white light
It is made of something like glass
It is black and speaks in his mind
It hums and burns his bare hands
quiz.e: It comes in a metal sheath, its blade looks black and trails dark smoke, and a cheerful voice asks whether he would like to destroy some evil today.

chapters.title: The Four
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: A young member or descendant of a family, especially an important one.
In a way that can never be undone.
The bar between a blade and its handle that protects the hand.
A weight that balances another, as in a lift.
Something that stands for an idea in a human-like form.
Ancient, basic and powerful, from the very beginning.
A risky move made to gain an advantage.
To formally demand supplies for official use.
A raised platform, often for a throne or speaker.
The hard, clay-like sediment that highstorm rains leave on everything.
A large and dangerous wild beast of Roshar.
The highprince who betrayed Dalinar at the Tower. He ignored Dalinar’s call to march and stayed behind in the warcamps, expecting the expedition to fail.
Adolin fought the Assassin in White during the battle and came out of it with a broken wrist and a bruised face.
Shallan found and opened the ancient Oathgate on the Shattered Plains, which carried the army to Urithiru. Working it takes a great deal of Stormlight.
The words every Radiant swears first: “Life before death. Strength before weakness. Journey before destination.”
Kaladin’s home town in Alethkar, where his parents live and his father is the town surgeon.

quiz.q: What does Dalinar find when he opens the balcony doors in his dream?
o: A storm rolling in over the hills
A deep, warm light that does not blind
Gavilar calling to him from below
The Shattered Plains under snow
quiz.e: A piercing warmth from a distant source he knows well bathes him. The Stormfather later says no vision was sent: it was “a simple dream”.

quiz.q: What does Sadeas claim about the new Radiants?
o: They are part of a show Dalinar staged
They are all secretly in Sadeas’s own pay
The Heralds sent them to punish him
They will turn on Dalinar before long
quiz.e: He calls it convenient that they include the head of Dalinar’s guard and Adolin’s betrothed. Adolin sees he doesn’t believe it but will spread the lie.

quiz.q: How does Adolin know for certain that Sadeas is dead?
o: Sadeas’s Shardblade appears beside him
His guards cry out from down the hallway
His eyes burn out and turn to smoke
Deathspren gather about the body
quiz.e: A Blade appears beside the body, the one that was once Dalinar’s. Adolin then dumps it out a window and hides his part in the killing.

quiz.q: Why did the Stormfather send Dalinar the visions?
o: Dalinar prayed to him for help
He hoped Dalinar would rule
Odium forced him to send them
The Almighty required it of him
quiz.e: He says he was required to send them once the time arrived: he could no more disobey than refuse to blow the winds.

quiz.q: Which words does Dalinar speak as his second oath?
o: “I will remember those who fell”
“I will seek the truth in all things”
“I will unite instead of divide”
“I will protect those who cannot”
quiz.e: He says he already knows his oath: he will bring men together. After a silence, the Stormfather accepts the Words.

quiz.q: What happens when Dalinar then summons his Shardblade?
o: It shatters on the stone of the roof
It turns to mist and will not form
The Stormfather tears it from his grip
Screams fill his head and he drops it
quiz.e: Screams sound in his head; he drops the Blade and feels the bond severed at once. The Stormfather had said he must give up that “monstrosity”.

quiz.q: What clue about Renarin does Dalinar finally understand?
o: He has begun to glow in the dark
He has stopped wearing his spectacles
He no longer sleeps through the night
He keeps a sphere in each pocket
quiz.e: Stormlight healed Renarin’s eyes. He is a Truthwatcher, the fourth Radiant, and the screams from his Blade explain why he froze in the arena.

quiz.q: Why does Kaladin decide to go to Hearthstone at once?
o: The king has ordered him to go there
Syl senses another Radiant there
His parents live there, among parshmen
He hopes to find more Stormlight there
quiz.e: His parents are there and the citylord keeps parshmen, whom the Everstorm will change. He means to fly, or rather “fall”, the whole way.

chapters.label: Epilogue
chapters.title: Art and Expectation
chapters.intro: A few reminders from earlier in the series, plus vocabulary. Nothing here describes what happens in the chapter.

items: The use of more words than needed.
Basic and simple; only partly developed.
To lessen the value of something.
Too high an opinion of oneself.
Practical and useful rather than attractive.
A belt worn over the shoulder and across the chest, with pockets or loops.
Combined effort that achieves more than each part could alone.
To rescue something from loss or ruin.
Doubt about whether something is true.
To understand and share another person’s feelings.
The King’s Wit, a black-clad jester who mocks everyone and tells stories. He sang Kaladin the tale of Fleet when he visited him in prison.
Before the expedition, Wit told Dalinar he would be leaving soon, warning that “the father of hatred” must not find him.
The new storm the Parshendi summoned, which blows the wrong way. The Stormfather told Dalinar it will transform the parshmen.
Kaladin, Shallan, Dalinar and Renarin are now Radiants, and the Alethi have reached Urithiru.
Great horses, like Dalinar’s Gallant and Adolin’s Sureblood, that choose their own riders.

quiz.q: Who makes up Wit’s audience as the Epilogue opens?
o: A lizard-crab-thing and some songlings
A crowd of curious farmers at the market
Two bored guards at a river ford
A caravan of merchants at camp
quiz.e: He talks to an ugly lizard-crab-thing on a nearby rock and plays his pipes to songlings, which seem to answer him.

quiz.q: In Wit’s story, what does the farmer do with one of the finest paintings ever made?
o: Sells it for a plow
Gives it to a princess
Uses it in the privy
Hangs it in his barn
quiz.e: Finding it near the privy, he uses it for that purpose, while the lighteyes praise the empty frame they find in the hall of art.

quiz.q: What does Wit call the true soul of art?
o: Originality
Familiarity
Endurance
Expectation
quiz.e: Give people more than they expect and they will praise you all your life; give an ounce less than they imagined and you have failed.

quiz.q: How does Jasnah first respond on seeing Wit?
o: She embraces him with clear relief
She points a Shardblade at his neck
She collapses, too weak to stand
She asks him where her family is
quiz.e: Mist snaps into a long, thin sword at his throat, and she demands to know how he found her.

quiz.q: What does Wit tell Jasnah when she says they must find Urithiru?
o: That it lies under the Plains
That it fell long ago
That it is already found
That it is only a myth
quiz.e: To each of her fears he answers that it has already happened: the Voidbringers are here, Urithiru is found, and the Knights are partly refounded.

quiz.q: Where does Wit say Jasnah will find God?
o: Inside the hearts of men
In the words of the Heralds
Among the stars of the night
Within the highstorms’ heart
quiz.e: He says Tanavast was not God; God, and salvation, will be found inside the hearts of men. Jasnah agrees, for different reasons.
